Tooltip_LW_NeedParts: Requires electronics scrap and electric wire.
Tooltip_LW_NeedWater: Requires half a litre of water.
Tooltip_LW_NeedOutdoor: Must be placed outdoors, under the open sky.
Tooltip_LW_NeedWaterSide: Must be placed on the bank, next to water.
Tooltip_LW_NotABattery: This is not a usable battery.
Tooltip_LW_TooGood: This battery is in good condition already.
Tooltip_LW_NeedOverhaul: Only an overhaul can improve it further.
Tooltip_LW_SoundproofKit: Fitted on an inverter: no more hum, and zombies no longer hear it. The inverter runs warmer and wears 25%% faster.
Tooltip_LW_MonitorDisk: Installs the Live Wire management app on a Computer Mod computer or laptop.
Tooltip_LW_NeedDisk: Requires the Live Wire software disk.
Tooltip_LW_NeedSoftware: Install the Live Wire software (disk) on this computer first.
Tooltip_LW_VoltageTester: Right-click a tile to measure its power.
Tooltip_LW_DeepCycleBattery: Stores 1.5 kWh and lasts four times longer than a car battery.
